name: hnh
description: HNH × BrainSAIT Healthcare OS — unified Cloudflare Worker, Next.js frontend, satellite workers, and static sites.

scripts.workers:control-tower:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply control_tower_observability --config workers/control-tower/wrangler.toml --remote
scripts.workers:control-tower:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply control_tower_observability --config workers/control-tower/wrangler.toml --local
scripts.workers:control-tower:test:aggressive: node --check workers/control-tower/src/worker.js && wrangler deploy --config workers/control-tower/wrangler.toml --dry-run && curl -fsS https://portals.brainsait.org/control-tower >/dev/null && echo control_tower_aggressive_tests_ok
